_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The status readout ellipsizes the model name instead of overflowing in a narrow desktop pane. The screen is 1280x800, and every model's display name is "Predictable model with a very long display name". "Overflows" for a selector S means: take the first element matching S that is visible (non-empty getClientRects()) - there must be one - and compute scrollWidth > clientWidth + 1. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. data-testid "message-input" should be visible (allow 30s). 3. Eval document.querySelector(".main-content").style.maxWidth = "320px". 4. ".context-usage-label" should be visible. 5. ".status-bar-active", ".status-readout" and ".context-usage-label-tokens" must each not overflow (false). 6. Eval window.__shrinkChain() (the page already defines it; do not define it yourself), which lists every ancestor of the visible ".model-picker-value-name" up to the ".status-readout" as {cls, minWidth, isSelectLabel}: the result must not be null, some entry's cls must be exactly "status-readout", and every entry whose isSelectLabel is false must have minWidth exactly "0px". 7. For the first visible ".model-picker-value-name": its trimmed textContent must be non-empty, its computed text-overflow must be exactly "ellipsis", and it must overflow (scrollWidth > clientWidth + 1 is true).
